category: log, event and trace store queried with APL

free_tier.stated: Personal, USD 0/month, permanent, no credit card: 500 GB/mo data loading compute, 10 GB-hours query compute, 25 GB storage, 30-day retention, full APL access, all integrations; 3 datasets, 256 fields per dataset, 1 user, 3 monitors, US edge only
free_tier.notes: 500 GB a month is both the free allowance and the maximum data loading on Personal. One GB-hour of query compute is roughly the cost of scanning 1 GB with moderate complexity. Axiom Cloud, the paid plan, is USD 25/month plus usage and includes 1,000 GB of loading, 100 GB-hours of query and 100 GB of storage.

per_object_cap.stated: 1 MB per field, 200 bytes per field name, at most 10,000 events per ingest batch; 256 fields per dataset on Personal
per_object_cap.notes: The cap is per field, not per event, and applies on every plan.

retention.stated: Maximum data retention 30 days on Personal

egress.terms: All plans include unlimited bandwidth and API access, per the limits page; reading data back is paid in query compute, 10 GB-hours a month on Personal

interface_detail: REST API with JSON bodies: ingest and query at the edge deployment's base domain (us-east-1.aws.edge.axiom.co for the US edge, the only edge Personal supports), every other endpoint at https://api.axiom.co, authorised with an API token or a personal access token. api.axiom.co answered 401 to /v2/datasets without a token. OpenTelemetry metrics go to a /v1/metrics endpoint.
tooling: curl or any HTTP client with a Bearer token, and OpenTelemetry exporters
chaining: A 30-day searchable store for the logs of free compute services, up to 500 GB loaded a month, with only about 10 GB of it scanned by queries a month.

limits.value: 10 GB-hours of query compute a month
500 GB / month data loading, also the maximum on Personal
1 MB per field; 10,000 events per batch

binding_note: 10 GB-hours of query compute is roughly 10 GB scanned a month, against 500 GB that can be loaded, so querying runs out long before ingest.

identity_cost.detail: The sign-in page creates an account on the first sign-in and e-mails a login link; the pricing page states Personal needs no credit card. Whether a later step asks for a phone number is unverified: behind a sign-up.

reliability_note: An event that would exceed a dataset's field limit is rejected with an error; strings over the field size are replaced with a placeholder.
confidence_note: Every limit is quoted from a first-party page, and the API host answered 401 without a token. No account was opened; an authenticated ingest and query from a Personal account would move it to measured.
